data.narrative:
Seneca operates in the Drones & Autonomous sector at Series A stage, having raised $60M to date. The broader Drones & Autonomous universe comprises eight private companies including peers such as Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air, with no directly comparable public comps available for benchmarking.

The valuation analysis applies stage-progression methodology, which is the applicable quantitative approach given data constraints. Using total raised ($60M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A progression to subsequent rounds yields an implied valuation of $120M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Drones & Autonomous sector—while five peers exist in this space, none meet the minimum threshold of three datapoints after filtering for stage and valuation tier relevance.

The triangulated valuation range is $102M (low) to $138M (high), with a median of $120M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology and should be treated as preliminary pending collection of nearer-stage peer transaction data. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x step-up multiplier for this particular sector and stage transition, the absence of public market comparables, and limited visibility into the performance trajectories of the peer set. Additional data on recent Series B valuations within Drones & Autonomous would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
